Contact Us What We Do? We deliver our services in a unique way The core competence of dreitier is a far-reaching understanding of software architecture and development, system design, the operation of software products and the associated tactical and strategic issues. Our range of services includes: Advisory Our Advisory-as-a-Service provides unlimited access to our expertise, helping you solve IT challenges faster and more efficiently. Learn More Consulting Our IT consulting offers expert guidance to optimize your infrastructure, ensuring efficiency, robust security, and scalable growth. Learn More Productized Services Our most popular services, offered at a fixed scope and set price, are tailored to meet the common business needs of our clients. Learn More Why Choose Us? We love solving your technical challenges Throughout our professional careers, we have gained the ability to evaluate new technologies and methodologies, as well as analyze existing systems at both a high and detailed level. We enjoy solving problems and answering complex questions using our analytical skills, and we are always eager to share our knowledge with those who are interested. Get In Touch Reducing time to market Software development is a broad field, and with us, your team has a trusted partner for architectural and technical challenges. We enhance your software development lifecycle, implementing strategies that reduce time to market. Minimizing operational risk We ensure your software functions seamlessly both locally and in production. With our extensive experience in software operations, we identify and recommend proactive measures early on, minimizing operational risks. Laying a foundation and helping with decisions We proactively keep you informed about new products, risks, and strategies for managing your software. This allows you to focus on implementing new features for your customers while we handle the technical aspects. We do not promote bleeding-edge technologies; instead, we offer proven solutions that stand the test of time. dreitier offers a unique perspective on our customer's IT needs by providing expert advice at every level — from the byte level to the strategic implementation of IT infrastructure. Steven CEO What is our approach? We conduct business differently As a company that operates exclusively remotely, we find it incredibly important that we clearly communicate our values and expectations of our work, our environment and our colleagues. dreitier is shaped by our own experiences. Our core values and principles are guiding us. Our Philosophy Core Values The core values guide us in our daily work and how we shape the company. Learn More Principles Our principles are overarching and are divided into social and company principles. Learn More Code of Conduct Our Code of Conduct defines how and with whom we work - or not. Learn More Common Understanding Our Common Understanding describes what phrases and formats you can expect from us. Learn More Our vision is for dreitier to be the trusted go-to for IT enthusiasts, providing confident and reliable solutions in software engineering and operations. Christopher Founder and CEO Cannot get enough of us? Check out some of our recent news Whitepaper Do's and don'ts during DevOps projects We are currently writing a whitepaper on the do's and don'ts of DevOps projects, drawing from over three decades of consulting experience. The whitepaper will be published in the middle of the first quarter of 2025 on our social media channels. 02 Oct 2024 Software All-in-one solution for high quality documentation We have begun developing swark, a tool that enables IT and software architects to manage their operating environments using an advanced data model. It allows static content to be stored programmatically via the framework and dynamically maps diagrams. 06 Sep 2024 Partnership dreitier joins Unternehmerverbände Niedersachsen e.V. Today, dreitier joined the Unternehmerverbände Niedersachsen e.V., the umbrella organization representing Lower Saxony's business community. It includes around 70 employer associations, collectively representing over 140,000 companies. 01 Aug 2024 Software Portfolio management for consulting expert We have entered the testing phase of our software, kwilo, designed for consulting experts to manage their projects, experience, and skills all in one place. With just a few clicks, you can export expert profiles and tailor it to match project requirements. 11 Jul 2024 Strategy Shifting the focus towards a software business We are intensifying our focus on software to meet the growing demands of our customers' digital transformation. By prioritizing innovation, scalability, and customer-centric solutions, we aim to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving market of service providers. 07 Jun 2024 Partnership dreitier becomes emerald partner of SUSE We have deepen our strategic partnership with SUSE as we become emerald partner status. They offers a wide range of enterprise ready open source solutions and we are proud to be their partner by implementing the solutions together. 03 May 2024 Convinced yet?
